name: Phone
author: AlteringUX
description: Hands-free voice phone calls with LLM-backed contacts. A phone icon opens a contact picker; picking one starts a real-time spoken conversation (mic -> whisper -> NanoGPT -> Piper), with barge-in, per-contact voices and personas, tool use (web search), durable cross-call memory, and opt-in incoming calls. Engine + state owned by ~/.local/bin/omarchy-phone.

barWidget.description: Phone icon for the bar; click for the contact picker and to start a call. Shows a live pill while a call is connected. Contacts have fixed personas, distinct voices, tools, and memory that persists between calls.
